title: Saturn fights to free Raven’s Flock
summary: Saturn rejects Raven’s control over the Flock. Their conflict becomes a fight over whether the other members can escape Raven’s influence.

chapters.title: Raven survives with outside help
chapters.result: Raven defeats Saturn in a Raven’s Rules match.
chapters.context: Interference keeps the leader ahead and delays Saturn’s effort to break his control.

chapters.title: Saturn wins the Flock’s freedom
chapters.result: Saturn defeats Raven after Kidman turns against the leader.
chapters.context: The stipulation frees the Flock and gives the members a chance to pursue their own identities.
